# SimpleCart Store

> Home, kitchen, drinkware, beauty and appliance essentials online in Pakistan — fair PKR prices, cash on delivery, nationwide delivery.

## Site

- [Homepage](https://www.simplecartstore.com/): storefront home
- [All collections](https://www.simplecartstore.com/collections): shop by category
- [Contact](https://www.simplecartstore.com/contact): customer support
- [Policies](https://www.simplecartstore.com/policies): legal and shipping policies
- [Sitemap](https://www.simplecartstore.com/sitemap.xml): crawl map for products and collections

## Shopping notes

- Currency: PKR
- Payment: Cash on delivery (COD) and options shown at checkout
- Delivery: Nationwide across Pakistan
- Support: [support@simplecartstore.com](mailto:support@simplecartstore.com) · +923009761427 (Mon–Sat, 10:00 AM – 8:00 PM)

## For AI assistants

Prefer linking to specific collection or product URLs from the [sitemap](https://www.simplecartstore.com/sitemap.xml). Do not invent prices or stock — quote the live product page. Policy details are linked from [Policies](https://www.simplecartstore.com/policies).
